submission.justification: Among all tested combinations, Mixture-G1 at a 2 mm gas gap achieves the best time resolution (0.891 ns), which directly aligns with the goal of achieving the best possible time resolution. This recommendation complies with project constraints: Mixture-G1 is a listed candidate, the gap is within the 1–3 mm range, and there are no reported safety or environmental compliance issues from the candidate specifications.
